_doc: Realistic prototypes real-1 (proto/real/1 plane door, 2 Chilean miners, 3 inside lightning). Photoreal stills: SDXL base 1.0 + SDXL-Lightning 8-step UNet (CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M) via .github/workflows/zack-images.yml; prompts kept short (CLIP 77 tokens), photo words first, faces small / from behind. p* = plane, m* = mine, l* = lightning.
style: 35mm lens, film grain, shallow depth of field, photorealistic
